slides.title: Words you'll see on Swedish roads

caption:
Fart in Swedish just means speed. Infart is the way in for cars and utfart is the way out, so yes, you'll see "Utfart" on garage doors.

A speed camera is a fartkamera, and a speed bump is a farthinder.

Could you keep a straight face on a Swedish road trip?
